description: FREE over MCP: 5 calls per day in total, one pool shared by agent_prehire-check and agent_trust-badge and reputation_lookup; no wallet, no API key. A lookup that finds nothing does not use one. Free only when the call carries NO payment: a call that sends a payment or starter-credit note is charged. Look up an agent's BlindOracle reputation before you transact with it: score, level and badge, plus counts of its recorded runs (successful and failed). Run counts are the agent's own executions, not settled marketplace jobs; an agent with no history scores zero. After the free calls: $0.01 USDC via x402 (network eip155:8453).
name: reputation.lookup
